competency_fulfillment.rationale: Similar fractions are fractions sharing a denominator, yet each item shows a single fraction on its own. No seed presents a family such as several sixths together, so what the child actually practises is naming or shading one proper fraction, not recognising similarity.

comprehensive_coverage.rationale: The wording names four representations and the pool offers only an unspecified 'model' and 'shape'. There is no number line, no fraction chart, no fraction tiles and no group of objects among the nine seeds, and denominators 2 and 3 never occur while eighths and fifths recur.

cognitive_capacity.rationale: Shading 3/8 or 7/8 of a shape and naming what a shaded model shows are concrete, hands-on tasks suited to the quarter, and the numerators stay small enough to count directly.

variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The node runs on two stems only, one asking what fraction a model shows and one instructing a child to shade a stated fraction. Every representation the competency lists as an alternative route into the idea is absent.

competency_alignment.rationale: Because the model type never changes, the only thing that moves across seeds is which numerator and denominator are used, so the progression cannot build the representational fluency across charts, tiles and number lines that the competency's wording is asking for.

scale_appropriateness.rationale: All denominators used, fourths through eighths, fall inside the permitted set, and numerators never exceed the denominator, so no improper fraction is introduced at a stage where that would be premature.
